title: Britax Recalls Strollers Due to Risk of Fingertip Amputations and Lacerations
summary: The stroller's hinge mechanism poses a fingertip amputation and laceration hazard to the child when the consumer is unfolding/opening the stroller. Units: About 14,000 in the United States and 900 in Canada.

title: Pull Toys Recalled by Manhattan Group LLC Due to Choking and Aspiration Hazards
summary: The toy has wooden components that can break or come loose, posing a choking/aspiration hazard to young children. Units: About 2,400 in the United States and 400 in Canada.

title: Tiny Love Recalls Wind Chime Toys Due to Puncture and Laceration Hazards
summary: The wind chime toy can be pulled apart exposing sharp metal rods, posing puncture and laceration hazards to the baby. Units: About 600,000 in the United States and 200,000 in Canada.

title: Innovage LLC Recalls Discovery Kids Lamps Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: A defect in the lamp's printed circuit board can cause an electrical short, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 360,000.

title: Dollar General Recalls Toy Guns Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The orange tips located at the end of the toy guns' barrels, which are designed to distinguish them from real guns, can easily be removed from the barrels, posing a choking hazard to children. Units: About 9,600.

title: Children's Greeting Cards with Bracelets Recalled Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The surface paint coating on the bracelets sold with greeting cards contain excessive levels of lead violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 6,800.

title: Children's Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Recalled by New Mode Sportswear Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The children's sweatshirts have a drawstring through the hood, which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 7,200.

title: Children's Jackets with Drawstrings Recalled by GTM Sportswear Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The children's jackets have drawstrings through the hood, which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 210,000.

title: Children's Toy Jewelry Sets Recalled by Playmates Toys; Charms Violate the Total Lead Standard
summary: A cylindrical metal connector on a charm can contain levels of total lead in excess of 300 ppm, which is prohibited under federal law. Units: About 252,000.

title: Climate Control Footrests Recalled by Fellowes Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The footrest's fan can become blocked and overheat when used in the upright position, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,000.

title: Commercial Ice Cube Machines Recalled by Scotsman Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The solenoid, an electrical component in the product, can fail and result in an electrical arc that can pose a fire hazard. Units: About 43,000.

title: Sportime Recalls Children's Floor Hockey Sets Due to Lead Paint Hazard
summary: The surface coating on the boards, which are assembled together to form the floor hockey playing-field, contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 580.

title: Arctic Cat Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Fuel can leak from the fuel pump at the fuel tank mounting screws, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,300.

title: Bristol Model and Martha Stewart Collection Enameled Steel Tea Kettles Recalled Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The handle on the tea kettle can come loose, posing a burn hazard to the consumer. Units: About 132,000.

title: Bobens Trading Recalls Girls' Hooded Sweatshirts With Drawstrings Due to Strangulation Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Burlington Coat Factory
summary: The hooded zip sweatshirts have a drawstring through the hood which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 3,900.

title: Children's Hooded Jackets Sold Exclusively at Burlington Coat Factory Recalled by Franshaw Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The jackets have drawstrings through the hood which can pose a strangulation hazard to young children. Units: About 2,400.

title: Children's Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Recalled by Baycreek Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The sweatshirts have a drawstring through the hood which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 1,900.

summary: The CO2 and temperature sensors can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 9,400 units.

title: Girls' Hooded Sweatshirts Recalled by Weeplay Kids Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The sweatshirts have drawstrings through the hood which poses a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 11,800.

title: Motor Controllers for Submersible Pump Systems Recalled by Franklin Electric Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The product label can lose adhesion, exposing the circuitry. This could pose a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 38,000.

title: Allreds Design Recalls Baby Bracelets and Pacifier Clips Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: The recalled bracelets and pacifier clip clasps contain high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 900.
